item.title: A Timeline of Gracie Abrams & Paul Mescal’s Relationship
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome back to "Love in the Spotlight"! Today, we're diving into one of the most buzzworthy romances in the entertainment industry: Gracie Abrams and Paul Mescal. This power couple has been making waves, and we're excited to share their story with you.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: So, how did it all start? Well, it turns out that Paul Mescal, the Irish actor from Normal People, was a huge fan of Gracie Abrams' music even before she became a pop sensation. The two had interacted online years before they first stepped out together in public in 2024.
[Short pause]
Host: Fast forward to today, and both Gracie and Paul have been killing it in their respective careers. Gracie's had multiple hits on the Billboard Hot 100, while Paul has starred in major blockbusters like Aftersun and Gladiator II. But what about their personal lives? Before getting together, Gracie was briefly linked to DJ Hayes Bradely, and Paul was in a long-term relationship with singer Phoebe Bridgers.
[Soft music continues]
Host: Although they kept their relationship under wraps for a while, Gracie and Paul have since become more comfortable sharing their love with the world. They've been spotted at events together and even share adorable photos on social media. And get this - they live together in a cozy London home filled with musical instruments, where Paul's been perfecting his portrayal of Paul McCartney for an upcoming Beatles biopic.
[Short quote clip of Gracie Abrams from Rolling Stone]
Host: As Gracie told Rolling Stone, Paul's talent is out of this world. "He's like an alien," she said. "He's better at guitar backwards than I have been at guitar my whole life."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: And that's a wrap on Gracie Abrams and Paul Mescal's love story. Stay tuned for more updates on this power couple and other celebrity romances.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
